textoCompleto: On a warm summer day, an ant was busy working. She was carrying grains of wheat to her colony. She walked back and forth, back and forth, all day long. A grasshopper was sitting on a leaf, singing and playing his fiddle. He watched the ant and laughed. 'Why are you working so hard, ant? It is summer! Come and play with me,' said the grasshopper. The ant stopped for a moment and said, 'I am preparing for winter. Winter is very cold, and there is no food. I must store food now so my colony can eat.' The grasshopper laughed again. 'Winter is far away! Why worry about it now? You should enjoy life like me.' The ant continued working. The grasshopper continued playing every day. Summer passed, and autumn came. The days became colder. Finally, winter arrived. There was snow everywhere. The grasshopper had no food. He was very hungry and very cold. He went to the ant's colony. 'Please, ant, can you give me some food? I am starving,' said the grasshopper. The ant looked at him. 'What did you do all summer?' she asked. 'I sang and played,' said the grasshopper. The ant replied, 'While you were singing and playing, I was working. I prepared for winter. You did not. Now you must face the consequences.' The grasshopper learned his lesson: it is important to work hard and prepare for the future.
